Nice to see you again, (playername). Still getting adjusted to life in White Ash Harbor?_Things move at a slower pace here than in Billboard City, but you'll get used to it.
I wish you had seen this town in its prime. What a sight it was . . . and it didn't reek of fish! Blegh!
Have you ever tried dry aged meat? The flavor is out of this world.
Pomarine gave me that hunting bow as a birthday present._I know she meant well, but if it had been a health drink I would've actually enjoyed it. Haha!
Most people prefer the sun, but I like myself a cool rainy day. It really calms me.
I really should get my steps in like you do, (playername). Maybe one day!

Can I tell you something? I've been living my dreams for the last fifteen years and this butcher shop is it. Not many people can say that._Passion and dreams are what's needed in life. What are your dreams for Le Sequoia?
I have a lot of plans in my head. We'll see what works!
I don't know just yet, this is all new to me.
As does any owner of an establishment, but planning without action won't keep the lights on._You have to work for it. I mean, reeeallly work for it!
Understandable, but if Chef Casteau gave it to you, he must have seen something in you.
I promise my meat is sourced ethically. At some point it had a name, breathed air, and saw sky._You should always eat something that had a name. It's how you know people cared for it.

I don't like to get political, (playername), but our mayor, Gavin, is just the pits._He's all show and no go in terms of getting anything done around here._He barely won last election, but I think he'll be out on his keister next time.
I always admire Hasel's ability to try new things with her drinks. She has such an adventurous spirit.

I'm going to reveal a little secret about myself: I don't do veggies._I know, I know, they're good for you, but I can barely stomach them even when they're cooked down and paired with a nice steak. Served raw? Forget it!
When I was a boy, I used to go exploring in the woods when I wasn't on my grandfather's fishing boat._Used to hear all sorts of odd things out there. Whispers in the trees and such. Pretty creepy.
You ever notice it's the small things in life that can really make your day? Like, getting the knife in the joint and popping it is just so satisifying._Do you get that feeling from butchering meat?
. . . what?
. . . yes, I get that feeling.
Well, it's simply a joy to feel, at least to me.
Right?! It's such a satisfying sound. Hearing it reminds me that my time spent learning this trade has paid off.

Have you talked to Bowie yet? He's my grandfather! He has some amazing stories to tell. I learned about a curing technique that they use overseas from him._Only have six more months of waiting to see if it worked.

I had a terrible experience this morning, (playername). I went to butcher a delivery and found my knife was . . . dull!_The shame of it all! I would never use a dull blade on a piece of meat. It's too cruel!

You know what one of the hardest things to make is, (playername)? Good barbecue._I love how meat can be transformed when it's cooked barbecue style. There's nothing better in the world than that and that's a fact!
Hahaha! (playername)! (playername), I got a joke for you! What do you when you're addicted to seaweed?_Seek Kelp! Get it? Hahahaha! I'm going to tell that one to Mae-Lou later!

Even though we don't see eye to eye on . . . well, many topics, I always admire Nabiha's stall._It reflects her values and her personality so much. I don't do vegan at all, but I respect someone who stands behind their beliefs.
My job is important and I love it, but there are days when I feel no joy while I do it._Somedays, I feel like my wheels are spinning for no reason._You ever feel that way, (playername)?
I know what you mean, Uriel. I have those days, too.
I always feel a sense of joy when I'm cooking.
I'm glad to hear that I'm not the only one feeling like this, but I just wish it would stop.
Then I hope you always have that joy in your heart. I know I find what I'm doing to be joyful . . . but I haven't felt it in a while.
It's been a while, but when the newest season of The Masquerade Ball comes back I'm going to watch it. I love seeing those dancers move!

Pomarine gave birth to 12 kids, raised them, and fed them even after her husband left her and the children._How she was able to adapt to such adversity is beyond me, but it led to her being the best hunter in White Ash Harbor.
Sorry for venting so much earlier. I'm okay! I . . . I just need to unwind._It's been busy. So busy . . .

I feel like I will work in my shop until the day I die. Look at Grandpa Bowie!_He's still doing the fishing thing at his age, but he's telling stories of adventures and stuff and . . . where am I? Here, always here.
Maybe I should take a walk on the beach sometime . . . there's always something to look at and enjoy there.
I look around and see how much the town has changed, and it's because of you, (playername)._You helped make this happen. I cannot thank you enough.
Aw, Uriel! Thanks, man!
This town saved me too.
Credit where credit is due, my friend!_You did something here that most of us, myself included, never thought we would see in our lifetimes: White Ash Harbor coming back to us.
You made your name here because of your efforts, and White Ash Harbor is thriving because of the chance you were given here._Life can be beautiful sometimes.
(playername), don't let people take advantage of you. They'll think they can get you cheap because you're young._Always get what you think you're worth.
Even though we aren't the closest of friends, I appreciate Aloys because he checks in on Bowie daily for me._He's a good guy for doing that for me.

My entire family is into fish. They fish it, sell it, make recipes for it. Me? I can't stand the smell of it._Couldn't get into it, so I figured being a butcher was the next best thing, since I'd developed my knife skills on my family boat.

Getting together with my dad is fun, but truth be told, there's some friction between us still._He and mom haven't been completely happy about my choice in becoming a butcher. Makes Thanksgiving awkward, you know?

I'm glad that we talk, you know. Chatting with you helps me forget some of the more dreadful things in my life._ I think a lot of people wrestle with the choices they've made. I know I have, but having a friend like you makes it bearable.
Good morning, my filet mignon!_I am going to save some amazing cuts of beef for us.
Oh, you don't have to do that for me!
Mmmm, that sounds lovely.
It isn't a matter of 'have to,' I want to. I want to treat us to the finest I can find because that's what we deserve.
There's a New York strip I have aging right now that will be amazing in a few weeks.
Since we've been together, I have started to see life as something that isn't my job._I have started to see the many layers that it can have and I want to see it all with you.
I hope that we go the distance because I really think that what we have is very special.
I'll probably never stop working because I enjoy what I do so much, but I will never allow my job to come between us. Never.
I'm trying to not jump ahead of anything . . . But . . ._. . . But when we're old, and it's the end of the day, I'd like to just have some tea and hold your hand while the day unwinds.
I know we're together, but I am going to lay this out for you: I don't expect you to give up your dreams for me._I hope I just get to be there to see you shine.

Congratulations on opening your restaurant, (playername)!_This is the fun part, the start of it, where you see if your dreams fly or crash into a fiery ball of sadness._It'll probably be the happier one! I'm sure of it, maybe.
I read Lucius' review of your food. Your food is great and everyone here agrees._I don't care if he liked it or not, critics shouldn't have that much power over people's minds!

Great job getting the bathhouse up and running again._That took some guts! I always heard it was huanted, not that I believe in ghosts . . . because if I did, then I'd be in trouble in my line of work, haha! Well done!
Well done with Le Sequoia! I've been hearing folks walking around talking about it and they are all saying how amazing it is. Keep going, you got it!
I had a few customers talk about the teahouse the other day. Makes me want a hot cup of tea after a long day of cutting and preparing meat.
I've been watching you answer those bulletin board requests, and someone has to say it: Good on you for helping people out.
Your work with the bulletin requests is making folks around here a lot more pleasant. You're a good person for doing it. Keep it up!
The menu at Le Sequoia is very intriguing, to say the least! I haven't heard of some of these dishes, (playername), but they sound yummy.
That menu you've got at Le Sequoia is very exciting. I cannot wait to try what you're making with my meat!
I dunno about your menu right now, it feels kinda . . . off. It needs more meat options, in my opinion.
I don't think I'm going to eat at your restaurant right now. The menu isn't sitting well with me at the moment.
Way to keep this town clean and running, (playername)!_The quality of meat available will go down if we lose the environment it likes to graze around and eat.
Clean air and a healthy forest are key to keeping our little town happy and healthy. Thanks for making sure we're safe.
I really cannot stress how much I hate the trash floating around here._If it makes its way into the livestock, I cannot promise that the quality of the meat won't go down.
If we don't get a handle on all of this pollution soon, I will have to resort to alternate forms of protein, and trust me, you don't want that happening.
(playername), thanks for the help again with that delivery. I really need to remember it's okay to ask for help, even when it's not an emergency.
Looking at the ocean the other day was really relaxing, because it felt like I wasn't there for a moment, and it was peaceful.
. . . Oh, right. I . . . I just don't get it some days, you know? Why do I show up here? Why should I . . . never mind. Don't fret about it.

My passion for feeding people was why I got into this job. I lost sight of that over time._The work was all I saw, and I didn't see myself outside of it. Thanks for reminding me that even though my work is important, I am too.

After realizing that making my life about work wasn't living, I decided to try some hobbies._I tried the usual ones like making a ship in a bottle, knitting, but they weren't doing it. I almost gave up, until I discovered . . . dance! I love it.

It's funny, my mental health really wouldn't be where it is without your help. Life doesn't need drastic changes all the time._Small things we can do for ourselves are really what's needed, more often than not. Thank you.
Uh, thanks?
My apron needs to be washed soon. There's blood on it.
I d . . . don't understand why you think that, but okay.
These skills have taken years to hone. Thanks for the compliment.
Look, I have been doing this for a few years now, I know I got it. Thanks.
Sure, that would be very helpful.
No need, I've dealt with a lot more in the past.
Hey, this is pretty awesome! Thanks!
Ah, how did you know? I feel better drinking this.
Really appreciate it, (playername). This is really good for me. Too much meat and all, you know?
This looks really valuable! I don't really need this, but I appreciate the thought.
Hey, you remembered! You are a good friend, (playername).
I think this is pretty neat, but I don't need it.
Thanks, (playername), but I do not need this.
What's this? Do you want me to keep this?
Thanks, but you've already given me something today.
Heyyy, there we go. Now go wash your shirt, it's got blood on it.
Sorry, I'm covered in blood, a lot of blood.
Hello! Welcome to Chop! What can I get for you?
What can I get for you?
Welcome! What would you like to order today?
Chop, where the knives don't stop when they hit bone. What can I get you today?
Come on in! We've got some amazing specials today.
Yum! That one is my favorite.
Good buy, that cut is prime!
Ah, great choice!
I haven't seen its like, I'll take it.
Look at this!
Great! I can use this.
I can't use this, but thanks anyway.
Sorry, don't need this.
I don't need this, but someone else might.
Are you sure you don't have any credits in your pockets?
Hmmmm, doesn't look like you can afford this.
You'll need some more credits, sorry!
Sup. Hope those shrimp worked out for you.
I've been around a lot of shrimp, and I gotta say, they are feisty little guys.
Be ready to snap that fishing line tight when the bobber goes down. The fish here are fast.
If you find any shells on the beach, be sure to see if Bowie wants to buy them. He's always buying that kind of stuff.
I'm gonna grab a boba from Hasel. She's always got something new going on.
(playername), how's the restaurant going?
Okay. But it could be better.
Not well. It's been stressful.
If the stresses of owning Le Sequoia ever become too much to handle, let me know, and we'll do some fishing.
Running your own ship takes a lot out of you, but I hear it's worth it. Let's do some fishing sometime to take the stress off.
Shrimp scampi, shrimp cocktail, shrimp gumbo, shrimp by itself. There are many ways to eat shrimp.
Shrimp is delicious, but don't eat it every day. Shrimp is a 'sometimes' food.
Just between you and me and the sea, this job is just a job for me. What I really want is to get into robotics.
One of the things that brings me joy is getting a new hat. I love having choices when it comes to headwear.
Man, I hope that old bathhouse opens again one day. A long time in a hot bath sounds good after a day on the boat.
(playername), I gotta know._How do you find the time to do life between your job and everything else?
If I'm honest, I don't know. I just do.
Work is my life.
I've come to understand that the choices we make matter just as much as the ones we don't. Either way, they affect your life.
I agree. I think work-life balance is a myth because life is work._Some of that work pays you and some of it makes you into who you are today. Yep, that feels right.
I usually wind up at Bianca's with Hasel. We're constantly trying to keep Hasel running._She's not just a project, but a friend too. She's just the nicest.
Bianca can come off a bit . . . harsh sometimes. Just know it isn't you, per se, but rather she's so smart she doesn't remember how to talk to other humans.
White Ash has been my home since forever. I dig its vibe._Some people want to run away from their hometown, but I like where I live.
When Bianca and I get together, we work on a puzzle while talking about engineering solutions for problems around town.

If you ever wanna hear a story, go talk to Bowie. But be careful, because man, he doesn't know when to stop talking._It might seem rude, but just walking away is sometimes the only option. Just an FYI.
Finding a good friend is hard in today's world, but (playername), you've been a solid one to me.
Aw, thanks man!
Having a friend like you makes it easy to be one.
You gotta keep quality people in your life and let them know you see the good they do. Keep on being you.
We're like opposite magnetic poles, (playername)! We work seamlessly, easily, and keep each other together.
Tinkering away at home with my gear brings me joy. I hope I get to make things here in White Ash Harbor and never leave.
Once people know my ambitions, they ask why I haven't gone to university? My one-word answer is: cost.
I just don't want to be a fisherman my whole life._Running my own boat will make me more money, but it isn't what I want to do forever.
I want to make something that makes life better. Not just for me, but for everyone._It's dreaming, but I'm not going to sleep through this life, that's for sure.
Finding the time to get through some of the thoughts in my head is hard. It's why I carry a small notebook._Jot it down, put it away. There, I got it out, and I feel good about it.
(playername), I wanted to tell you something, but I don't know how to say it.
We're friends, you can say it.
This sounds serious. Everything okay?
Okay, well . . . Your drip is basic. Whew! It feels good to get that off my chest.
How people dress, including myself, is important to me. Please know that when I say, 'Your drip is basic,' that it's coming from a place of love.
I'd recommend checking out what Milo has in stock in his shop. He has some wild one-of-a-kind items available in there.

Lots of tourists just ask me questions like, 'where do you fish in your off time?'_It doesn't occur to these people that humans are allowed to be 3 dimensional, ya know? It would break their brains to know I read fashion magazines.

It's a shame that we live in a time with so many threads to choose from but most folks don't care._Do yourself a favor, (playername), don't do a hoodie and sweats all the time, okay? You're better than that.
We've known each other for a while now, so if you don't want to be alone, you can always call me._No one should ever feel like they're alone. No one.
Whenever I see you, I feel like the future is a bit brighter.
That's sweet of you to say.
I see a sunrise that will never set.
It's the truth.
Hey, I was trying to romance you more! Haha! I love it.
You know how you have someone special? Whether you're talking or being quiet, you're doing it together, and it's never a bother.
If anything, we should really get some matching threads sometime. Yeah, I'm that kind of nerd when I love someone.
It's been a day, but you know what helps make it better? Knowing that I'll be able to hold your hand.
I just feel so alive right now, you know? The fact that you chose to be with me just makes me feel like I can do anything.
I love you more than I have ever loved anyone. Sorry for spilling that out with no lead up, but it's what sits in my heart day in and out.
Hello. New to town?
What can I do you for?
Looking to become a fisherman?
Sup.
Got any hats? I like hats.
Grats, (playername). Must feel good getting that done. Le Sequoia's grand opening, that is.
I heard some dude named Lucius did a write up on your place._I didn't read it, too busy, but I'm sure the guy sucks. Don't worry about whatever he said.
Hey, I didn't know you were helping with the bathhouse._That's pretty damn cool. I'd love to check out those steam machines. Old timey tech is so tactile!
Been hearing a lot about Le Sequoia here on the docks._Tourists seem to be showing up more and more too. Guess that's your doing, huh? 'Grats, man.
I'm gonna go to the tea house after work sometime. I heard you did an amazing job with it. Not gonna lie, enjoying afternoon tea sounds super relaxing.
Yo, I've been seeing you running around here. Getting these small asks done for folks. You're a solid person for doing all that.
Hey, keep it up with all that do-gooding you've been doing.
I heard your menu is pretty epic with a great seafood selection. I'll have to check it out.
Man, that menu is wild. I am so glad you are committing to seafood.
I heard about your menu . . . I think I'm good.
I'm going to pass on the menu right now, it isn't really my bag.
Keeping the waters clean keeps my paycheck safe. Thanks for making that happen.
You are always making sure what you're doing isn't messing with the rest of us. I appreciate it.
Hey, others see how you do things, so try to not trash our waters, 'kay?
Your actions speak for you, (playername). Trash sucks, and right now, so do you.
Now that I have my BMD, I can harvest all the raw materials I need for making . . . anything! Thanks again for the fish, (playername).
My quota isn't going up, which is good. Gotta keep that work-life balance. Be good enough at the job, but not so good that I keep getting more work. You dig?
I took the BMD out for a trial run, it's sooo good! LET'S GOOOOOO!
Going to college was something I thought would never happen. It's crazy that this is even happening! Thanks.
I dunno what to bring to college, clothing-wise. I'm so used to wearing these grubby clothes all the time. I'll have to thrift a few more things before going. Ya know, update my look.
This is it, I'm heading out for college. (playername), I've said it a lot, but thanks for helping me out with this.
Even after being on my feet for 13 hours, I still get compliments. Thanks.
These threads aren't even my best. Come out on a Saturday night and you'll see my best.
I am a student. Always will be.
Mhmmm.
Umm, cool.
Sure.
Nope.
Aces, man.
This hat, man. It's great. I might even wear this.
Top notch! Thanks, (playername).
This looks like it cost a pretty penny. Not really my vibe, but I'll still keep it.
Hey! This is a sick gift. You made my day better, and it's already a great day!
Yeah, nah. I'm good.
Nah, but thanks, man.
You got anything else? No? Ok, I'll just hold onto it.
Thanks, but you've already given me something today.
You can let go now.
Sorry, I'm a bit busy today.
Yo, whatcha need?
We have some great fishing rods.
Be careful out there. The ocean is wild and unpredictable.
Ah. Are you a fellow angler too?
You won't be disappointed.
This one is great.
I use that one every day.
Solid pick.
I can take it from here.
Not bad. Not bad.
Sure, I can use this.
I'm good, thanks though.
No thanks, man.
I don't need this, but someone else might.
You need more credits. This isn't a charity.
It doesn't look like you can afford this.
You'll need some more credits, friend.
Salutations, (playername)!_I hope you're adjusting to your new surroundings, because if you don't, then that will make living here hard. Okay, bye!
In White Mash Barber, I mean White Ash Harbor, there are plenty of places to go and see. Like that volcano just over there. It's something to see!
My facial expression and my attitude match, as I am very excited to be here, but my mind still wanders around a good amount.
When I'm making boba tea, I will always add something new to the mix._Experimenting with fruity ingredients like dragon fruit, pears, and grapes is what I love!
Hi! Have you ever noticed how boba teas are like solar systems with tiny tapioca planets?
Tight Rash Bobber . . . bzzzt . . . I mean, White Ash Harbor I believe is on the verge of becoming awesome._It just needs a push, and I think that push is you.
I find a lot . . . bzzzzzt, of people think that androids live forever._After being found in the trash bin I can safely tell you that we do not. Haha!
I'm still sorry that even happened to you.
Who did that to you? Do you remember?
Ahhhh . . . bzzzzt . . . D'aww, thanks! That's nice of you to say. I have made it a goal to move past that moment in my life and with each passing day I achieve that goal.
I couldn't tell you. I only remember being here in White Ash Harbor._Bianca and Aloys were the ones who found me and got me working again and we've been friends ever since.
When I woke up in White Ash Harbor, I started reading anything I could get my hands on, and so I read a lot of manuals._Why doesn't anyone read those? They're full of information!
Philosophy is super intriguing!_These thoughts about the universe, about life on this planet, and about life itself just made me think, 'What if a boba tea could fix all those questions?'
A lot of people don't like gloomy days. I look at it as a day that will never come again!_How exciting is it to see the world in this shade of light!
Prisca is one of the most passionate people I have ever met. Her love for our town is unmatched._She can be a bit gruff sometimes, but it's only because she wants only the best for our community.
When I'm not at the stand I like to explore. I love finding all of the . . . bzzzzz, abandoned things.
I was told that I came from Billboard City, though I have no memory of my life from when I lived there._Do you have a previous life you do not recall?
Uh, no, I remember everything about my life.
There are parts of it I wish I couldn't recall.
How nice it must be to remember everything._Do you remember when you were born? I bet that was exciting!
I have remembered every day since my friends found me._Every smile, tear, and hug. Both good and bad days utilize those same emotional responses. Isn't that interesting?
Without Aloys and Bianca, I'd be falling apart!_They keep me running and I give them free boba in return.
Friends are great to have, and I count you among them now._I know I'm friendly, but friendship isn't something I hand out to anyone. You have joined an exclusive club, (playername).
I hope I never forget my friends. I don't get sad . . . it's literally impossible for me to be sad. But that would make me sad.
Friends make life better. When Bianca, Aloys, and Milo are tinkering with my brain, it's a blast!
Milo has a fun little shop down by the water. If you want some . . . bzzzz, great clothes, I would go there.
(playername), I've been feeling off lately. You know how I'm usually scatterbrained and such? This isn't anything like it. It's worse. What should I do?
What are your symptoms?
Why not talk to Bianca or Aloys?
My vision goes in and out and my logic buffer fails._This morning I held a very strong belief that cheese comes from comets. But I'm fine. I am fine.

I can't afford an inspection from Bianca. Also, she . . . bzzzzzzzzzztt, pulls out my electronic brain and uses it for pickleball._And Aloys is fishing for compliments in the sea! HIS HATS ARE LOVELY!
